title: Join Analytics
description: JoinAnalytics is a custom-coded Minecraft server plugin designed for the PaperMC software. Its primary purpose is to provide server administrators with clear, real-time data regarding their player base without the need for heavy external databases.
body:
JoinAnalytics is a lightweight but powerful player tracking solution for modern Minecraft servers.

# Features:
Live Analytics: View daily new players, returning veterans, and total unique players with a single command (/stats).

Veteran Detection: Automatically broadcasts a message to admins when a player returns after a customizable amount of time (default: 30 days).

First-Join Celebration: Welcome brand new players with a customizable Aqua firework to make their first visit memorable.

Playtime Tracking: Identifies the top active players currently online to help admins reward loyalty.

Admin-Only Privacy: Tab-completion is restricted to authorized staff and does not leak player names in the command suggestions.

PlaceholderAPI Supported: Use placeholders like %joinanalytics_total% to integrate your data into other plugins seamlessly.

# Permissions:
joinanalytics.admin: Grants access to the stats dashboard and the plugin reload command.
